title: Building Blocks
note: Images are copied from game textures; machine and block images use a representative face. Crafting recipes may be overridden by modpacks. Machine crafting recipes describe how to build the machine, not its processing recipes.
scope: Registered tree logs, planks, leaves and wooden shapes, ore blocks, compact metal/raw-resource blocks, glass, cement and lighting. Machines and functional storage blocks have dedicated categories.

items.name: Pyretic Titan Volcanite Leaves
items.description: A Pyretic Titan building resource produced by growing its rare sapling in the Demetrian Bonsai Planter.

acquisition.note: Obtain a Pyretic Titan Sapling through the rare grafting mutation (5% with eligible Tartarean Netherite or Adamantine Diamond species), then grow it in the Demetrian Bonsai Planter to produce Pyretic Titan logs and leaves.
